_about: The board logo's design (KICAD.md K32), measured from the 50 footprints KiCad's Image Converter traced from the PNGs in CAD/Logos/, 2026-11-14. generate.py draws every logo from these numbers and the font's outlines, and checks the library's footprints against them.
_font: Bebas Neue 2.000, the copy the DOCS and the KIMulator ship, under the SIL Open Font License (OFL.txt).
_height_units: The logo's height H is "6502" from the top of its 6 and 0 to their bottom, overshoots included: 720 font units (-10 to 710). All 50 footprints measure H to within 0.007 mm of their names.
_centre_units: The font height that falls on the logo's centre line, for "6502" and for the name alike: the middle of the digits' overshoots, and the middle of the capitals (0 to 700). Measured to 0.003 mm.
_name_scale: The name is set at half the scale of "6502" (measured 0.4993 to 0.4999).
_gap: From the end of the 2's advance to the origin of the name's first letter, as a fraction of H. 44 of the 50 footprints measure 0.1600 to 0.1606 (115.1 to 115.6 font units).
_flatten_tolerance: mm: how far a straight segment of the generated outline may be from the font's curve.
_size_tolerance: mm: the printed shapes' width and height must agree this closely with the library's footprint (KICAD.md K32).
_outline_tolerance: Per mm of H: how far any point of a letter's outline may be from the library footprint's, after the two logos' printed shapes are centred on each other (0.02 mm on a 5 mm logo). The traces were made at 1182 pixels to the logo's height (0.004 mm a pixel at 5 mm) and are 0.02 to 0.08% small; the 44 that follow the design measure 0.0022 to 0.0038 of H.
_png_height: The picture written to CAD/Logos/ is this many pixels tall, as every source PNG is, black on white at 300 dpi.
